s01.heard: Does an athlete have to look a certain way to perform at their best?

s02.heard: Athletes can have different body types, ectomorph, mesomorph, or endomorph.

s03.heard: Different shapes, different physical characteristics,  but body shape alone does not determine sporting ability.

s04.heard: Because in sports, what matters is not just how your body looks, it's what your body can do.

s05.heard: Your strength, speed, endurance, agility, mobility, and, most importantly, your game output.

s06.heard: Unlike bodybuilding, where physique and muscular development are central goals, sports performance  is about delivering results in your game.

s07.heard: Every sport has different physical demands, every athlete has different needs.

s08.heard: That's why every athlete needs to be understood individually.

s09.heard: Through necessary assessments, sport-specific fitness goals, and continuous training,  athletes must keep developing their physical capabilities.

s10.heard: Different physiques, different sports, different requirements, one focus, better performance.

s11.heard: Sports Science Technology Understanding the Athlete Beyond Physique
